text: The authors list possible approaches to semi-supervised RL, including supervised reward learning (train a model to predict reward from state and use it, with uncertainty weighting, on unlabeled episodes), semi-supervised or active reward learning (e.g. the agent identifies salient events and requests their reward), and unsupervised value iteration (use transitions from unlabeled episodes for more accurate Bellman updates).
title: Approaches to semi-supervised RL: reward learning, active reward learning, value iteration
